The user capability and six semantic operations are preserved, while transport/discovery are Android-adapted.
responsibilities.production_wiring: FabushiRemoteDeviceGateway registers exactly FabushiAppAgentSurface.ToolNames after obtaining the typed account-scoped device Agent session. Calls are admitted through RemoteCommandJournal, dispatched on the Android main thread to the native semantic surface, and terminal results are journaled before wire reply. Surface action requires exact generation, stable agentId/ref and an allowlisted action; semantic elements do not carry sensitive values. The Android messaging shell now keeps the same native App Surface owner while projecting a stable Mahayana Assistant semantic id on the chats list and active Assistant chat, removes it from Channels and regular-conversation contexts, and exposes the Desktop-compatible unread-none semantic node only while the Assistant is inactive on the chats list. The child ConversationHome reports only presentation context back to the parent publisher and does not create a second semantic owner. Desktop refreshes conversation.list after Assistant open/completion so unread UI does not use stale projection. Android adapts this to its native split Agent surface: the Rust Host persists a last-read marker beside the canonical transcript, computes unread only from visible Assistant replies paired with visible user turns, exposes typed projection/mark-read through CoordinatorPort, and MarketplaceViewModel refreshes the projection on transcript restore and Assistant completion. Opening or actively viewing Assistant acknowledges through the Host owner; hidden MCP continuations cannot create unread.
